workspace_path.description: Absolute or relative path to repository root.

target_files.description: Optional relative file paths to scan instead of full workspace.

tools.description: Run SOC2 logical-access audit (JWT/session + RBAC patterns) against workspace files. Writes results to runsec-report.md.

workspace_path.description: Absolute or relative path to repository root.

target_files.description: Optional relative file paths to scan instead of full workspace.

tools.name: runsec_audit_hipaa
tools.description: Run HIPAA safeguards audit (PHI/PII logging + integrity) against workspace files. Writes results to runsec-report.md.

workspace_path.description: Absolute or relative path to repository root.

target_files.description: Optional relative file paths to scan instead of full workspace.

tools.name: runsec_audit_general
tools.description: Full workspace security audit (user intent: @runsec audit). Runs static engines plus mandatory agent architectural review (missing controls: auth, RBAC, rate limiting, CSRF, secrets-by-design). Writes runsec-semantic-brief.json; execute agent_instructions (7 phases incl. Step 2.5) and submit_agent_findings. Hub sync when API key is set.

workspace_path.description: Absolute or relative path to repository root.

target_files.description: Optional relative file paths to scan instead of full workspace.

tools.name: runsec_ignore_finding
tools.description: Persist an accepted false positive to .runsecignore.yaml (rule_id + file_path + line SHA256). Matching findings are excluded from future Semgrep audits in this workspace.

workspace_path.description: Repository root where .runsecignore.yaml will be written.

rule_id.description: Semgrep rule id or metric token (e.g. PY-001, runsec.domain-input-validation.cwe-89).

file_path.description: Relative path to the file within the workspace.

line_content.description: Exact source line at the finding (used to compute SHA256 fingerprint).

line_sha256.description: Precomputed SHA256 of line_content; use instead of line_content when already known.

tools.name: runsec_list_skills
tools.description: List RunSec security skills (language/framework packs) with activation triggers, extensions, and pattern counts for remediation routing.

tools.name: runsec_get_context
tools.description: Return index.md and patterns.md for a skill_id, plus optional RAG hints and skill orchestration for a file or question.

question.description: Optional question to fetch RAG hints within the skill.

file_path.description: Optional file path for skill orchestration scoring.

file_content.description: Optional file snippet for orchestration scoring.

tools.name: runsec_ask_guidance
tools.description: Semantic search over RunSec safe-pattern knowledge base. Returns top safe patterns and fix templates for a vulnerability description (anti-hallucination remediation).

question.description: Vulnerability description, metric id, or remediation question (natural language).

tools.name: runsec_threat_model
tools.description: STRIDE architectural threat model: analyzes Syft SBOM, package.json, docker-compose, and repo signals. Writes runsec-threat-model.md and .threat-model-cache.json in the workspace.

workspace_path.description: Absolute or relative path to repository root.

project_name.description: Optional project name used to infer architecture profile (kubernetes-api, desktop-gateway, generic).

context.description: Optional free-text context (stack, deployment model, integrations) to refine STRIDE analysis.

tools.name: runsec_update_threat_model
tools.description: Save IDE-agent STRIDE threat model to <workspace>/.runsec-cache/threat-model.json for reuse on the next audit (delta-oriented Step 2 in agent contract).

workspace_path.description: Absolute or relative path to repository root.

threat_model_markdown.description: Full or delta-merged STRIDE threat model markdown produced by the IDE agent.

profile.description: Optional architecture profile label (e.g. kubernetes-api, generic).

scope_files.description: Optional relative paths covered by this threat model revision.

tools.name: runsec_generate_review
tools.description: Penetration-tester / auditor report: runs a full GENERAL unified scan plus STRIDE threat modeling, then writes runsec-security-review.md (executive summary, business-risk findings, audit exclusions). English-only; distinct from runsec-report.md.

workspace_path.description: Absolute or relative path to repository root.

project_name.description: Optional display name for the security review document header.

context.description: Optional deployment context (stack, integrations, regulatory scope) for STRIDE profiling.

target_files.description: Optional relative file paths to scan instead of the full workspace.

tools.name: runsec_get_semantic_targets
tools.description: Return high-value authorization/business-logic review targets, expert prompts (DRF/FastAPI/Flutter baselines), and JSON finding schema for the IDE agent. No remote LLM calls — the Cursor agent performs semantic review locally.

workspace_path.description: Absolute or relative path to repository root.

context.description: Optional deployment/architecture notes to refine profile detection.

target_files.description: Optional relative file paths to scope target selection.

include_static_baseline.description: When true (default), run a quick static merge pass to rank targets against Semgrep hits.

tools.name: runsec_apply_remediation
tools.description: Apply a deterministic safe-pattern patch to a file. Verifies target_line_or_block matches exactly, validates replacement against Skills catalog, writes a .bak backup, then patches the file.

workspace_path.description: Repository root containing the target file.

file_path.description: Relative path to the file within the workspace.

rule_id.description: Metric or rule id from RunSec skills (e.g. DVS-001, PY-001, DOCK-010).

target_line_or_block.description: Exact line or multi-line block currently in the file (must match before patch).

replacement_code.description: Approved secure replacement; must align with safe_pattern/fix_template from runsec_ask_guidance.

tools.name: execute_ephemeral_script
tools.description: Run a polyglot ephemeral security test: writes content to <workspace>/.runsec-temp/, executes command from workspace root (10s timeout), returns stdout/stderr, then deletes the script. Use {file} in command for script path.

workspace_path.description: Repository root; script is written to .runsec-temp/ under this path and command runs with cwd here.

finding_id.description: The ID of the finding you are trying to verify (e.g. django-cors-wildcard). This MUST match the id you will use in submit_agent_findings.

filename.description: Basename for the ephemeral test file (e.g. test_bola_poc.py, poc_test.go).

content.description: Full source code of the ephemeral test (mock DB / in-memory only).

command.description: Shell command to run from workspace root. Use {file} or {filepath} for the script path.

tools.name: execute_live_poc
tools.description: Execute a live HTTP request for API/network PoC validation (10s default timeout). Returns status, headers, and body (truncated at 256KB). Include finding_id matching submit_agent_findings — any completed HTTP response (including 4xx/5xx) records the PoC as executed for VERIFIED.

workspace_path.description: Repository root (for consistency with other verification tools).

finding_id.description: The ID of the finding you are verifying (e.g. api-bola-idor). Must match the id used in submit_agent_findings.

url.description: Full http:// or https:// URL to request (including path and query).

method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, or OPTIONS.

headers.description: Optional request headers as string key/value pairs.

body.description: Optional request body (raw string; use with POST/PUT/PATCH).

tools.name: report_cognitive_feedback
tools.description: Train the adaptive cognitive filter: record a False Positive (FP → AI_VETOED) or True Positive (TP → CONFIRMED_TP) for a static hint fingerprint_hash from runsec-semantic-brief.json. After two FP vetoes the finding is auto-suppressed on future scans.

fingerprint_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint from static_hints[].fingerprint_hash in the semantic brief.

verdict.description: FP = agent vetoed false positive; TP = confirmed true positive.

reason.description: Optional rationale stored with the feedback entry.

tools.name: runsec_get_active_findings
tools.description: Retrieve active/open vulnerabilities from sealed .runsec-cache/report.json (user intent: @runsec fix active findings). Returns unsealed agent_findings and static_snapshot summary — use instead of reading report.json manually.

tools.name: submit_agent_findings
tools.description: Canonical findings store + Hub sync (user intent: @runsec verify and sync). Default: merge by id (partial submits update only listed findings; others preserved). Use replace_all:true for full audit terminal submit. Remove fixed items via resolved_ids or finding resolution: resolved|false_positive. verification_status enum is strict; poc_output is mandatory on upserts.

workspace_path.description: Repository root where runsec-report.md will be updated.

replace_all.description: When true, incoming findings replace the entire cache (minus resolved_ids). Default false: merge by id. Auto-enabled when static audit is newer than last agent sync.

is_new_audit.description: Set true on the first submit after runsec_audit_* to force replace_all (clears ghost findings from prior audits).

resolved_ids.description: Finding ids to remove from cache (fixed/false positive). Use with partial verify submits; omit ids you want to keep unchanged.

findings.description: Structured findings only — server renders Markdown. Do not submit pre-formatted report text.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. django-cors-wildcard (rendered as runsec.agent-review.<id>).

location.description: Repository-relative file path to the vulnerable file or config.

verification_status.description: Strict enum — MANUAL, FAILED, and any other value are rejected. VERIFIED: Only use if an ephemeral script or live network request successfully exploited the vulnerability. POTENTIAL_RISK: Use if the ephemeral PoC failed (e.g. missing network/DB), but the code flaw is evident. STATIC_FLAW: Use for purely infrastructural/config issues (Dockerfiles, CORS, ALLOWED_HOSTS) that do not require live exploit scripts. ARCHITECTURAL_GAP: Use when a critical security control is missing by design (no JWT/session layer, no RBAC, no rate limiting, no CSRF). No PoC script required.

description.description: STRIDE / impact analysis and reasoning (plain text, not Markdown).

poc_output.description: MANDATORY exploit / validation evidence — NOT the file path alone (that belongs in `location` only). FORBIDDEN in poc_output: repeating `location`, only a path, or placeholder text. VERIFIED: paste stdout/stderr from execute_ephemeral_script OR live PoC output AND include the execution_attestation token (runsec-attest:...) returned by the tool. POTENTIAL_RISK: (1) why live PoC could not run, (2) quoted vulnerable code lines, (3) a concrete example attack (curl -X POST ... or step-by-step scenario). STATIC_FLAW: quoted vulnerable config/code lines PLUS an example misuse scenario (e.g. curl to exposed endpoint, docker port probe). ARCHITECTURAL_GAP: logical threat analysis — how the missing control enables specific STRIDE threats (Spoofing, Tampering, Elevation, etc.); cite repo-wide evidence (file tree, entrypoints, absence of auth middleware). Minimum ~40 characters unless VERIFIED tool output is shorter.

compliance_tags.description: Map the finding to relevant compliance frameworks. Use exact strings: 'PCI-DSS', 'SOC2', 'OWASP'.

remediation_prompt.description: REQUIRED for every finding. A direct, actionable prompt for an AI coding assistant (Cursor, Copilot, etc.). Include the target file path from `location`, the exact nature of the flaw, and specific instructions to rewrite the code securely. Plain text; no Markdown tables.

resolution.description: When set (with id), removes this finding from cache instead of upserting. Use for fixed/vetoed items during verify sync.
